breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both Dirichlet and periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only includes the Dirichlet boundary conditions, `u(0, t) = 1` and `u(1, t) = -1`, completely omitting the incorrect periodic instruction.
